author: amjdwl
quote:
- Feminist agenda and forced woke messaging
- Sanitized writing that completely lost the classic GTA edge and satire
- Locked at 30 FPS in 2026 with noticeable frame drops, even on PS5 Pro
- Slow, restrictive gameplay that feels more like a chore simulator than a crime sandbox
- Over-realism at the expense of actual fun and player freedom
- No PC version at launch
- 13 years of waiting for a massive disappointment
